scope: Completion, abort and private owner status services only. HTTP controllers and background recovery remain in their planned SIs.

implementation.ownership: Resolve user channel through ChannelsService; owner-qualified repository reads before claims/storage. Foreign or absent videos are VIDEO_NOT_FOUND.
implementation.completion: Exclusive fenced 180s completion lease; HeadObject recovery before session-expiry decisions; authoritative ListParts validates count/order/each size/total. CompleteMultipartUpload and HeadObject run outside database transactions. Destructive S3 calls require the same live claim with >=60s remaining.
implementation.atomic_commit: Existing fenced completeUpload transaction writes actual_size_bytes, processing and one outbox intention; safe old diagnostics are cleared. Re-read after ambiguous SQL response recovers committed state. Actual SQL error after outbox insert proves rollback of both video state and outbox; completed source is preserved for retry.
implementation.replays: Processing/ready completion returns persisted identity/status without storage calls or duplicate outbox. UPLOAD_ABORTED replay preserves terminal state/timestamps. Incompatible states reject.
implementation.abort: Exclusive abort lease. Head before abort and after confirmed abort/NoSuchUpload detects completed sources, reconciles them into processing and rejects false abortion. Recovered expired abort intent finishes original abort instead of processing remaining parts.
implementation.validation: Missing parts release only the owned live claim and remain resumable. Size mismatch first persists a durable diagnostic while still draft, aborts the session, deletes any divergent completed source via new storage-port deleteObject, confirms absence, then marks terminal error. Cleanup outage leaves recognizable pending intent and zero outbox; retry after lease expiry resumes cleanup.
implementation.expiry: Uncompleted expired draft is aborted and persisted as UPLOAD_EXPIRED; a completed valid source is recovered even when upload session has expired.
implementation.status: Private status uses explicit projection id/slug/status/errorCode/createdAt/updatedAt; allowlisted persisted error codes only. No keys, upload ids, raw messages or storage access. Existing upload-service projections use the same mapper.
implementation.errors: Typed StorageError maps to sanitized STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE except explicit not-found reconciliation. Unexpected SQL/programming errors propagate. Failed ownership/token/lease predicates never permit stale writes or destructive cleanup.
implementation.wiring: VideosModule registers/exports VideoUploadCompletionService. No HTTP controller, queue publisher or worker activated.

documentation.provider: Context7 MCP JSON-RPC; resolve-library-id before query-docs
documentation.version_discrepancy: Returned docs target master/main rather than pinned installed versions; flagged before implementation and cross-checked with installed declarations and real runtime tests.

limitations: No HTTP endpoints are implemented by this SI.
A persisted outbox intention is verified; queue publication and FFmpeg worker execution remain in later SIs.
Small real byte fixtures exercise multipart transitions; this does not replace the later full 10GB transfer, content-validation or RSS acceptance proof.
Automatic background recovery remains in its planned SI; this SI verifies owner-request recovery after expired claims.
